A '''Klatooinian''' served as the [[captain]] of a [[Klatooinian raiders|group]] of [[Pirate|raiders]]. The [[Klatooinian]] led a number of attacks on a [[farm]]ing village on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]]. When the villagers requested assistance in dealing with the attacks, the [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]] and the ex-[[shock trooper]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] provoked the Klatooinians, leading to a skirmish in which [[AT-ST Raider|their AT-ST]] was destroyed and the leader was [[Death|killed]] by the [[farmer]]s [[Caben]] and [[Stoke]]. Having been defeated, the remaining Klatooinians fled, ceasing their attacks on the village.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Klatooinian raider appeared in "[[Chapter 4: Sanctuary]]," the fourth episode of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 4" /> which aired on [[November 29]], 2019.<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[Sala Baker]]. Despite the raider's apparent death in the episode,<ref name="Chapter 4" /> the actor claimed the character would return in the show's [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] prior to its release.<ref name="Raider Return">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ibtimes.com/mandalorian-season-2-spoilers-more-romance-familiar-planet-2970290|text='The Mandalorian' Season 2 Spoilers: More Romance At Familiar Planet|author=Sachin Trivedi|date=2020-05-05|quote=The TV series appears to be taking Din Djarin back to Sorgan. Stunt performer Sala Baker let it slip recently that he will be back on the show this year, Bespin Bulletin reported. The actor played the role of the Klatoonian Raider Captain on the show before and he may be reprising the role in "The Mandalorian" Season 2.|archivedate=20200505101245}}</ref> However, the character did not make an appearance in the season after it aired.<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}</ref>
